title: Validation script — build, test, RT-safety, latency checks
description:
Create scripts/validate.sh as the CI/operator validation entrypoint for ShredEQ Release build, unit tests, and static/source checks covering RT-safety, zero-latency reporting, click-free bypass intent, and state round-trip coverage pointers.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- scripts/build_all.sh (configure/build patterns and presets)
- CMakePresets.json Release / linux-release (or equivalent) configure, build, and test presets
- CMakeLists.txt test target name (ShredEQUnitTests / ctest integration)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §18.1 (audio-thread rules: no heap/locks/IO on audio thread), §19.1 (zero-latency default / reported latency), §14.2 (gain-matched bypass / click-free), §17 / §21.8 (state save/restore)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §22 Release Criteria (validation scripts complete)
- Existing tests/*Tests.cpp names for ctest discovery

Implement scripts/validate.sh:
1. Shebang + set -euo pipefail; cd to repo root from script location.
2. Configurable BUILD_PRESET / CONFIGURE_PRESET defaulting to the project's Release preset when present (e.g. linux-release), otherwise document fallback to RelWithDebInfo with a clear stderr note — do not silently skip configure.
3. Steps (each section echoed clearly; non-zero exit on failure):
   a. Configure: cmake --preset "$CONFIGURE_PRESET" (or cmake -S/-B equivalent matching CMakePresets).
   b. Build Release (or chosen preset): cmake --build --preset … or cmake --build "$BINARY_DIR" --config Release -j"$(nproc)".
   c. Unit tests: ctest --test-dir "$BINARY_DIR" --output-on-failure (or cmake --build … --target RUN_TESTS / ctest --preset) so juce UnitTests run.
   d. RT-safety static checks: rg (or grep -E) over Source/ for forbidden audio-thread patterns that must not appear in processBlock hot paths without review — at minimum fail or warn-on-match with explicit allowlist comments for known-safe uses:
      - new / delete / malloc / free / realloc inside processBlock files (PluginProcessor.cpp and Source/DSP/**)
      - std::lock_guard / std::mutex / CriticalSection / MessageManager::callAsync in DSP process paths
      - fopen / ifstream / ofstream / juce::File on audio-thread named functions where pattern is cheap to flag
      Document that full proof is manual/host; script provides gated heuristics.
   e. Zero-latency verification: assert source/docs/code still treat default latency as 0 — e.g. rg for getLatencySamples and confirm zero-default / lookahead-only non-zero path in PluginProcessor (fail if getLatencySamples hardcodes a positive constant with no lookahead gate). Prefer source-level checks that work without running the plugin host.
   f. Bypass / click-free pointers: rg that gain-match / crossfade / bypass smoothing symbols exist (StateManager / PluginProcessor) so release gates are not vacant; do not require real-time audio fixtures in this script.
   g. State round-trip: ensure tests/StateTests.cpp (or equivalent) exists and is part of the test build OR rg UnitTest coverage for setStateInformation/getStateInformation / schema_version / A/B restore; fail if neither tests nor symbols exist.
4. Exit 0 only if build + ctest + required checks pass. Print a short summary: VERIFIED (automated) vs REQUIRES_MANUAL (host pluginval, DAW sidechain, Windows build) matching honesty required by phase L.
5. No DSP edits. Do not modify CMakeLists, Source/**, or docs (l.3 owns release docs).

verification_commands left empty — C++ adapter infers cmake/ctest when applicable; this task authors the script itself.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/validate.sh exists with set -euo pipefail and configures/builds using a Release (or documented fallback) CMake preset
scripts/validate.sh runs ctest (or equivalent unit-test invocation) with failure non-zero exit
scripts/validate.sh includes RT-safety static checks over Source/PluginProcessor.cpp and Source/DSP
scripts/validate.sh includes zero-latency / getLatencySamples source checks and state round-trip test or symbol gates
scripts/validate.sh prints a summary distinguishing automated vs manual/host verification
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change DSP algorithms or PluginProcessor behavior

allowed: bash validation script with cmake preset + ctest + rg/grep static checks
document fallback when Release preset name differs
print verified-vs-manual summary for host checks not runnable in CI
forbidden: require network services or online license checks
claim host DAW validation passed without running hosts
edit production C++ to make greps pass
